info.title: Subject Advisors admin academic setup API
info.description: Package A academic setup endpoints are wired to the SQL repository. All operations require an authenticated active SYSTEM_ADMIN. Every mutation has a trimmed 1-500 character reason and records the verified actor. Mutation bodies reject unknown fields. Current semester remains null until explicit admin selection. Migration 0008 is verified on disposable local PostgreSQL; shared development application awaits exact 0007 prefix/checksum integration. S2-P004-025 (migration 0010) adds Department between faculty and programme: programmes are assigned by department and the faculty follows from it.

post.description: The faculty must be active. Department codes are unique.

patch.description: Soft deactivation only. A department that still has programmes cannot move to another faculty (409 DEPARTMENT_HAS_PROGRAMMES); the target faculty must be active.

get.summary: List programmes with nullable department and faculty links

patch.summary: Assign or clear a programme department
patch.description: Sets the department and, in the same transaction, the programme faculty to the department faculty. Null clears both when the programme had a department (a programme without a department keeps its legacy faculty). The department must be active. Reassignment to another faculty conflicts while live coordinator assignments use the old faculty.
At least one field changes. Type and date invariants are checked against the merged stored row.

put.description: A single audited transaction switches the marker. Zero current semesters is a valid initial state.

post.description: Account must be active with active COORDINATOR membership. Centre and faculty must be active, and programme must link to that faculty. An ended assignment remains history; reactivation creates a new row.

IncludeInactive.name: includeInactive
IncludeInactive.description: Defaults to active options only; true includes deactivated management rows.

Programme.description: A programme with a department always carries that department faculty (facultyId/faculty are derived). A programme without a department may keep a legacy faculty until the admin assigns a department.

selectionOpensAt.description: Time from which students may pick offered subjects; null means selection is not scheduled.

selectionClosesAt.description: Time at which picking closes and coordinator decisions lock. Requires selectionOpensAt and must be after it.

SemesterFields.description: Semester 1 or 2 is NORMAL; semester 3 is SHORT. Dates may be null; end must not precede start.

code.description: Academic setup codes: INVALID_REQUEST, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, COORDINATOR_ROLE_REQUIRED, ACCOUNT_INACTIVE, REFERENCE_INACTIVE, PROGRAMME_FACULTY_MISMATCH, ASSIGNMENT_ACTIVE, ASSIGNMENT_ENDED, DEPARTMENT_HAS_PROGRAMMES. Existing auth gate also returns SESSION_REQUIRED, SESSION_INVALID, SESSION_ENDED, ROLE_DENIED, ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED and AUTH_UNAVAILABLE.

Conflict.description: Conflict, inactive reference, invalid account/role, faculty mismatch or a department with programmes moved to another faculty

Unauthorized.description: Missing, expired or revoked Clerk session (SESSION_REQUIRED, SESSION_INVALID, SESSION_ENDED).

Forbidden.description: Caller lacks active eligible SYSTEM_ADMIN access (ROLE_DENIED, ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED).

MethodNotAllowed.description: Unsupported method on known path; Allow header names supported methods.

Unavailable.description: Authentication or required dependency unavailable (AUTH_UNAVAILABLE or DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE).
